ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mercury and Mars

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and romance. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and family. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your image. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and friendships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and your career. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and intimacy. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and relationships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1804781775000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.
